en: Colored illustrated postcard showing a walled religious complex with an ornate arched entrance gate in an Islamic architectural style, a central domed building with surrounding arcades, and a tall slender minaret. Trees and a garden fill the courtyard, and multi‑story houses appear in the background. At the top, multilingual captions label the scene; a faint central word seems to read a city name, and on the right the French text reads "SAINTE SOPHIE". Greek text appears on the left.
